producer_report.summary:
The backtest now builds the introspection record from whichever D87 signal fired, and reports a finding when a decision is under review with no record. Root cause: `introspection_for` only read a fired run's intervention events. D87 under review through ar1x's derived host-error record has no events, so no record was built. `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked -q` all pass.

In `crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs`:
- **Sources:** `introspection_for` now takes the headers, records and starts. A new helper, `introspection_sources`, collects the cited interventions. Those are the run's intervention events, plus the source intervention of each derived host-error record. Each citation is checked with `validate_citations`, and any that fails is skipped. The record is built from the earliest by (time, id).
- **Skipped sources:** sources with no job are skipped. Observed host-error records are not sources, because they have no intervention row and the `Introspection` struct can't carry them.
- **Filter:** the D87 filter in `run_on_from` no longer has `!r.events.is_empty()`.
- **Finding:** when a decision is under review and no record was built, `run_on_from` pushes a condition-`d` finding for each such decision, naming it.

The tests are in `crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs`, not in the `backtest.rs` tests module. I added two:
- **ar1x fixture:** it reuses the existing `real_interventions` fixture, which copies the real ar1x text and time. It checks that D87 is under review, the introspection's intervention is ar1x, its job is `20261013-192156-9h2j`, its class of work is `code`, and there are no findings.
- **Missing record:** a fixture with an observed host-error record only gives a finding that names D87.

I changed one existing test, the observed-host-error one. It used to assert a clean pass. It now expects exactly one finding, condition `d`, naming D87. This is the intended new behaviour, because an observed record has no intervention to build from.

I also updated the module doc comment, `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/design/defaults-loop.md` §3.2.

checks_run.note: All suites passed, including the two new backtest tests and the changed one. The first run's output was persisted to a path I could not read, so I reran with -q.

open_issues: Observed host-error records can't source an introspection, because the Introspection struct needs an intervention id. A decision that fires only on an observed record is now reported as a condition-`d` finding. Supporting such records needs a schema change.
I did not run the backtest on the real records. The brief says that happens after landing.
mistakes: My first full `cargo test` run printed too much and was saved to a path outside the working directory, which a hook then denied reading. I did not route around the denial and reran with -q.
learnings: The backtest fixtures that copy ar1x live in crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs and write temporary records/ files; the in-module tests in backtest.rs hold none.
`earlier_cases` is always empty by construction, because the chosen source is the earliest of the run's citations. This was also true before the change. I kept the expression.
